servinfo.title: Passenger Air Bag (Inflator) Module Repair Harness Installation

s1.ptxt: Disconnect passenger air bag (inflator) module connector from passenger air bag (inflator) module.
Disconnect passenger air bag (inflator) module connector (3) from instrument panel harness as follows.

s2.ptxt: Release locking slider (2) by sliding it in arrow direction “1”.
Disconnect passenger air bag (inflator) module connector by pulling it in arrow direction “2”.

s1.ptxt: Remove passenger air bag (inflator) module harness (1) from steering support member (4).
Install passenger air bag (inflator) module repair harness to steering support member.
Connect passenger air bag (inflator) module repair harness to passenger air bag and instrument panel harness connector securely.
Check that no DTC is detected in SDM with ignition “ON”.
